model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the “effect” (y-axis, ranging from 0 to 30) of six different language model variants — mBERT-L₂, XLM-L₂, mBERT-R₂, XLM-R₂, mBERT-B₂, and XLM-B₂ — across nine language families or groups: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic (x-axis). Each group contains six colored bars corresponding to the models, with error bars indicating variability. The models are color-coded as follows: light blue (mBERT-L₂), dark blue (XLM-L₂), light green (mBERT-R₂), dark green (XLM-R₂), pink (mBERT-B₂), and red (XLM-B₂). The chart shows that the “effect” varies substantially by both language family and model, with the highest effects generally observed in the Semitic and Uralic groups (especially for XLM-B₂ and mBERT-B₂), while IE-Baltic and Isolate show the lowest effects across all models. The bars are not sorted by height, and the chart is presented at a diagonal angle for visual layout.
